rows.text: Your palm is sweaty. Maybe you will improve.
You lose your grip on your weapon; it flies 2d10 feet in a random direction. Next time wipe your hands first.

Overenthusiastic attack puts you off balance. You suffer a -5 initiative penalty next round.
-5 Initiative

Fighting sure is tiring! Take a -5 Fatigue penalty.
-5 Fatigue

You try to impress your opponent with a spin maneuver. Too bad. Spend two rounds Stunned.
2(-25 Stun)

You hit an innocent inanimate object. Both it and your weapon must make breakage checks.
Breakage
Execute the declared attack on the nearest ally, whoops! If no ally is in reach, an innocent  bystander will do. Failing that, attack an imaginary friend.

Your weapon's balance seems off somehow. Spend two rounds attacking at -25 before you realize your grip is wrong.
2(-25 Strain)
You are distracted and overwhelmed. You may not initiate an attack for two rounds (you may full parry if attacked).

You are suddenly very winded. Take a -20 Fatigue penalty.
2(-20 Fatigue)

You clip yourself with your own weapon. You are Stunned this round and Dazed next round.
-50 Stun, -25 Stun

You trip and fall prone as your swing goes wide. You are Stunned for two rounds, then Dazed in the third.
2(-50 Stun), -25 Stun, Prone

The excitement is just too much! Your momentary frenzy leaves you Stunned unable to parry this round, Stunned next round, and Dazed the third round.
-75 Stun, -50 Stun, -25 Stun
Execute the declared attack on yourself, with no parry DB. Ow!
My that weapon is heavy! You lose the opportunity to take a swing.
One hand slips from your weapon and it moves out of position; you lose the rest of the round recovering.

You mind wanders, and you partly lose control of your weapon. Suffer a -8 initiative penalty next round.
-8 Initiative

You stumble over an imaginary, invisible, deceased turtle. This leaves you Stunned for two rounds.
2(-25 Stun)

You launch a furious, but poorly-executed series of strikes that your opponent avoids easily. You only tire yourself. Take a -10 Fatigue penalty.
-10 Fatigue
You manage to completely lose your grip on your weapon, which ends up 1d10 feet away in a random direction.
Execute the declared attack on the nearest ally, whoops! If no ally is in reach, an innocent bystander will do. Failing that, attack an  imaginary friend.
The good news is that you successfully hit, delivering an 'A' Subdual critical. The bad news is, the target was yourself.

You strain your shoulders in a mighty swing (that misses). Take a -20 penalty.
-20 Injury

You confuse yourself and get your limbs all crossed. You are -50 for three rounds.
3(-50 Strain)

Your lower back screams as you twist too far and pull a muscle. You are Stunned two rounds and suffer a -25 penalty for the injury.
-25 Injury, 2(-50 Stun)

You go down hard on one knee. The pain leaves you Stunned for one round, then Dazed for the next.  The knee injury is a -15 flesh wound. You also drop your weapon.
-15 Injury, -50 Stun, -25 Stun

Your shoulder should not bend that way! You are Stunned for three rounds. The pulled muscle provides a -25 injury.
-25 Injury, 2(-50 Stun)

Worst move seen in ages! You are Stunned and unable to parry for five rounds and are at -30 with a pulled groin muscle.  There is a 50% chance your foes will be out for 3 rounds, laughing.
-30 Injury, 5(-75 Stun)
Sweat gets in your eye. You lose this round's attack to wipe it off.
What should be automatic with practice becomes clumsy as you overthink it. You fail to attack this round.
You spill your ammunition on the ground. Did you do something to offend the gods recently?

The projectile breaks, but half is still caught on the string. It requires 8 Action Points to clear it.
Staggered(8)
"Twang!" The projectile drives into the ground between your feet. It breaks.
Bow slips from your sweaty hands and falls at your feet.

Execute the declared attack on the nearest ally, whoops! (If no ally in range, put projectile through  your own foot for 2d10 hits and a -20 flesh wound.)
-20 Injury

You mishandle your weapon, causing yourself pain. Take one round Stunned.
-50 Stun
The bowstring snaps. Draw another weapon or restring your bow.

You managed to hold your thumb in the way of the string. Your shot misses, and you are Stunned for two rounds.
2(-50 Stun)
Your shot goes wild, landing 3d10 feet from target in a random direction. If someone is there, roll a +0 attack.

You slip and fall as you fire. Your shot goes astray. You are now prone and Stunned for two rounds.
2(-50 Stun), Prone
Make a breakage check. If it fails, the bow snaps and you take an 'A' Puncture from a flying splinter;  if it is passed, the string snaps and lashes you, doing an 'A' Slash critical.

You shoot yourself in the foot (A Critical). Your foot is pinned to the ground (6 Action Points to free yourself).  You are Stunned for two rounds, bleeding at 1 hit/round, and have a -30 flesh wound.
1 Bleed, -30 Injury, 2(-50 Stun), Staggered(6)
Not enough spin. Hold your attack until next round.

You have been overdoing it. Take a -5 Fatigue penalty.
-5 Fatigue

-10 Initiative
